description: PyTorch vs ONNX Runtime parity reference for MiniFASNet PAD models. Generated by scripts/export_minifasnet_onnx.py.
provenance_note: The GitHub release asset SHA-256 in scripts/model_checksums.json is authoritative. Re-exports with a different torch version may differ in bytes.

input.note: Each case stores its input as input_b64, base64 of the raw little-endian float32 NCHW bytes.
input.preprocessing: Raw BGR float in [0, 255]. Upstream commented out div(255); do not divide by 255 and do not apply mean/std normalization.
